This file fits the pre-registered LBA model for Exp 2 in the face familiarity study.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pkgs <- c(
  "EMC2", "tidyverse", "here", "parallel", "future"
  )
vapply(
  pkgs, library, logical(1), character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE
  )

## set options
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(),
        future.fork.enable = TRUE,
        future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore") ## automatically set in RStudio

supportsMulticore()

detectCores()

plan(multicore)

```

# 1. Read in data and wrangle

```{r}
#| label: read-data

raw <- read_csv(here("exp_2", "data", "data_exp_2.csv"))
head(raw)
glimpse(raw)
```

```{r}
#| label: wrangle

data_emc <- raw |>
  select(pid, cond, keypress, rt) |>
  rename(subjects = pid, S = cond, R = keypress) |>
  mutate(
    subjects = factor(as.integer(factor(subjects))),
    S        = factor(S, levels = c("Novel", "Learned")),
    R        = if_else(R == "q", "Learned", "Novel"),
    R        = factor(R, levels = c("Novel", "Learned"))
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

head(data_emc)
glimpse(data_emc)
summary(data_emc)
```

# 2. Preregistered model

## 2.1 Build model

```{r}
#| label: matchfun

matchfun <- function(d) d$S == d$lR
```

```{r}
#| label: design

design_exp2 <- design(
  data = data_emc,
  model = LBA,
  matchfun = matchfun,
  formula = list(
    v  ~ 0 + S:lM,
    sv ~ 0 + lM,
    B  ~ 0 + lR,
    A  ~ 1,
    t0 ~ 1
  ),
  constants = c(sv_lMFALSE = log(1))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: p-vector

p_vector <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 4, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 4,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 4, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 4,
  sv_lMTRUE            = log(.5),
  B_lRNovel            = log(2), B_lRLearned = log(2),
  A                    = log(.5), t0 = log(.3)
)

mapped_pars(p_vector, x = design_exp2)
```

```{r}
#| label: priors

mu_mean <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 0, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 0,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 1, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 1,
  sv_lMTRUE            = log(.5),
  B_lRNovel            = log(1), B_lRLearned = log(1),
  A                    = log(.5), t0 = log(.3)
)

mu_sd <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 2, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 2,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 2, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 2,
  sv_lMTRUE            = .5,
  B_lRNovel            = .5, B_lRLearned = .5,
  A                    = .3, t0 = .3
)

prior_exp2 <- prior(
  design_exp2,
  type  = "standard",
  pmean = mu_mean,
  psd   = mu_sd
)

plot(x = prior_exp2)
```

## 2.2 Fit model

```{r}
#| label: fit
#| eval: false

LBA_exp2 <- make_emc(
  data_emc, 
  design_exp2,
  type = "standard", 
  prior = prior_exp2,
  compress = TRUE
)

LBA_exp2 <- fit(
  LBA_exp2,
  cores_for_chains = 1,
  cores_per_chain = 24,
  iter            = 5000,
  step_size       = 500,
  verbose         = TRUE,
  fileName        = here("exp_2", "models", "tmp.rds")
)

saveRDS(LBA_exp2, "exp_2/models/LBA_exp2.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: load

LBA_exp2 <- readRDS("exp_2/models/LBA_exp2.rds")
```

## 2.3 Check model

```{r}
#| label: check

check(LBA_exp2)
summary(LBA_exp2)
#plot(LBA_exp2)
#get_pars(LBA_exp2, map = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-pars

plot_pars(LBA_exp2, selection = "mu", layout = c(3, 3))
```

## 2.4 Posterior predictions

```{r}
#| label: posterior-predictions
#| eval: false

pp_LBA_exp2 <- predict(LBA_exp2, n_cores = 24)
saveRDS(pp_LBA_exp2, "exp_2/models/pp_LBA_exp2.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-fit

pp_LBA_exp2 <- readRDS("exp_2/models/pp_LBA_exp2.rds")

png("exp_2/figures/pp_density.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 150)
plot_density(
  data_emc, 
  pp_LBA_exp2, 
  factors = "S"
)
dev.off()

png("exp_2/figures/pp_cdf.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 150)
plot_cdf(
  data_emc,
  pp_LBA_exp2,  
  factors = "S"
)
dev.off()
```
